ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 'Contagious Interview' / DEV#POPPER — node.exe spawning Stage-2 loader (BeaverTail → InvisibleFerret)
ucs.description: Hunts the exact pivot in Lazarus's fake-recruiter campaign aimed at blockchain/Web3 engineers: a trojanized npm package (BeaverTail JS) executes under node.exe and immediately spawns powershell/curl/python to pull the InvisibleFerret Python implant + browser-wallet exfil stager. The parent=node.exe + suspicious-shell-child + download/staging keyword combo is not typical developer telemetry — it's the documented Labyrinth Chollima initial-access shape (Unit42, Palo Alto; Securonix DEV#POPPER; ESET).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="node.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","pip.exe","pip3.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.process_name Processes.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process,"(?i)(Invoke-WebRequest|DownloadString|IEX|-EncodedCommand|urllib|https?://|\.n2|\.npl|p\.zi|brow\.zi|pdown|mlip|getCookie|wallet)") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LazarusStage2Tokens = dynamic(["Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-EncodedCommand","urllib","requests.get",".n2",".npl","p.zi","brow.zi","pdown","mlip","getCookie","wallet"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","pip.exe","pip3.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (LazarusStage2Tokens)
     or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)https?://(?!(?:[a-z0-9-]+\.)?(microsoft|github|githubusercontent|npmjs|nodejs|registry\.npmjs|jsdelivr|unpkg)\.)"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LazarusStage2Tokens = dynamic(["Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-EncodedCommand","urllib","requests.get",".n2",".npl","p.zi","brow.zi","pdown","mlip","getCookie","wallet"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\node.exe"
| where NewProcessName has_any ("\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\cmd.exe","\\curl.exe","\\wget.exe","\\python.exe","\\python3.exe","\\pip.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any (LazarusStage2Tokens)
     or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)https?://(?!(?:[a-z0-9-]+\.)?(microsoft|github|githubusercontent|npmjs|nodejs)\.)"
| where Account !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Lazarus Contagious Interview - node.exe Spawning Stage-2 Loader
id: 7a8f6a2d-3c1f-4e9a-bb44-1c5a0b0a8e21
status: experimental
description: Detects node.exe (likely trojanized npm package from a Lazarus fake-recruiter interview) spawning powershell/python/curl with stage-2 download or InvisibleFerret staging tokens.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/eset-research/lazarus-luring-employees-trojanized-coding-challenges/
  - https://www.securonix.com/blog/analysis-of-devpopper-new-attack-campaign-targeting-software-developers-likely-associated-with-north-korean-threat-actors/
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_node:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\node.exe'
  child_shell:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
      - '\pip.exe'
  stage2_tokens:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'IEX'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - 'urllib'
      - 'requests.get'
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
      - '.n2'
      - '.npl'
      - 'p.zi'
      - 'brow.zi'
      - 'getCookie'
      - 'wallet'
  condition: parent_node and child_shell and stage2_tokens
fields:
  - Image
  - ParentImage
  - CommandLine
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate npm postinstall scripts that fetch native binaries (puppeteer, electron). Allowlist on signed install paths or specific package context.
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.g0032
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @ParentImage:(*\node.exe OR *\Node.exe OR *\NODE.EXE) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\curl.exe OR *\Curl.exe OR *\wget.exe OR *\python.exe OR *\Python.exe OR *\PYTHON.EXE OR *\python3.exe OR *\pip.exe) @CommandLine:(*Invoke-WebRequest* OR *DownloadString* OR *IEX* OR *-EncodedCommand* OR *urllib* OR *requests.get* OR *http\://* OR *https\://* OR *.n2* OR *.npl* OR *p.zi* OR *brow.zi* OR *getCookie* OR *wallet*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/node\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|cmd|curl|wget|python|python3|pip|pip3)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(Invoke-WebRequest|DownloadString|IEX|-EncodedCommand|urllib|requests\\.get|https?://|\\.n2|\\.npl|p\\.zi|brow\\.zi|getCookie|wallet)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
| count > 0

ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 'Operation Dream Job' — trusted-vendor binary executed from user-writable / removable-media path (LightlessCan / BLINDINGCAN sideloa
ucs.description: Catches the user-double-clicks-the-recruiter-attachment moment used by Diamond Sleet / ZINC: a signed/trusted-vendor binary (trojanized SumatraPDF, fake Amazon coding assessment, PuTTY/SSH client, KakaoTalk installer, fake trading-platform updater, wsmprovhost.exe) launched by explorer.exe from Downloads/Desktop/Public/ProgramData/Temp or a D:-Z: drive letter (mounted ISO/IMG). Lazarus consistently pairs this signed-binary execution with sidecar DLL sideloading (colorui.dll, msvcr110.dll, mfc140u.dll variants) to load LightlessCan, BLINDINGCAN, MagicRAT or NukeSped.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="explorer.exe" AND (Processes.process_path="*\\Downloads\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Desktop\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="D:\\*" OR Processes.process_path="E:\\*" OR Processes.process_path="F:\\*" OR Processes.process_path="G:\\*") AND Processes.process_name IN ("AmazonAssessment.exe","SumatraPDF.exe","wsmprovhost.exe","PuTTY.exe","pageant.exe","plink.exe","colorcpl.exe","mstsc.exe","Notepad++.exe","CloudflareWARP.exe","KakaoTalk.exe","FreeAcrobat.exe","BinanceUpdate.exe","TradingTechnologies.exe","AnyDesk.exe","OpenVPN.exe","NordVPN.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.process_hash Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let TrustedLazarusLures = dynamic(["amazonassessment.exe","sumatrapdf.exe","wsmprovhost.exe","putty.exe","pageant.exe","plink.exe","colorcpl.exe","mstsc.exe","notepad++.exe","cloudflarewarp.exe","kakaotalk.exe","freeacrobat.exe","binanceupdate.exe","tradingtechnologies.exe","anydesk.exe","openvpn.exe","nordvpn.exe"]);
let UserWritablePaths = dynamic([@"\Downloads\",@"\Desktop\",@"\Public\",@"\ProgramData\",@"\AppData\Local\Temp\",@"\AppData\Roaming\",@"\Temp\"]);
let Exec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "explorer.exe"
    | where FileName in~ (TrustedLazarusLures)
    | where FolderPath has_any (UserWritablePaths)
         or FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$";
let Sideload = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where FileName endswith ".dll"
    | where FolderPath has_any (UserWritablePaths)
         or FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"
    | project SideloadTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, LoadingProcessId=InitiatingProcessId,
              SideloadedDll=FileName, SideloadedDllPath=FolderPath, SideloadedSHA256=SHA256;
Exec
| join kind=leftouter Sideload on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.LoadingProcessId
| where isnotempty(SideloadedDll) or FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          LureBinary = FileName, LurePath = FolderPath, LureSHA256 = SHA256,
          SideloadedDll, SideloadedDllPath, SideloadedSHA256, SideloadTime
| order by Timestamp desc
